_comment: The 3D topological_offset cases, hidden ([.]) so they never run in CI. Run them explicitly with ./wmtk_integration_tests "[offset]". THE THREE 2D CASES -- topological_offset_2d, _2d_vertex_input, _2d_dragon -- ARE TEMPORARILY REMOVED FROM THIS LIST, not deleted: their configs are still here and 2D is about to be reworked, so re-add them once it is. The 3D three were removed from integration_tests.json in data2 c414d7f for two reasons. Two of them -- topological_offset_3d and _3d_edge_input -- threw at construction on a both-surfaces check that erred on a flag pair rather than on the geometry; that is fixed in wildmeshing-toolkit 366c038e85. All of them then became far more expensive when the offset moved to an alternating A/B optimization: up to ab_max_rounds (10) phases of a full mesh_improvement each, where the old loop ran one, which is enough for topological_offset_3d alone to exceed the suite's 7200 s budget. Re-registering them in integration_tests.json is the whole fix once the A/B budgets are sized from measurement.
